title: Nomination to National Traders' Welfare Board
text: No. P-55015/2/2019-Internal Trade Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (Internal Trade and e-Commerce Section) ***** Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi Dated: 19'h June, 2023 ORDER In pursuance of the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade's Notification No. P-55015/2/2019-Internal Trade dated 26'h July, 2019 and the Notification No. P-55015/2/2019-Internal Trade dated 17'h December 2019, the Central Government hereby nominates the following persons to National Traders' Welfare Board for a period of two years or until further orders, whichever is earlier- i) Chairperson (Non-Official)- Shri Sunil Jeevrajji Singhi ii) Members (Non-Official) having special knowledge of matters relating to technical or other aspects of retail trade — 1.
